data.title: Care your parent would have chosen for themselves
data.subtitle: Companion care, personal care, dementia specialty, hospice support — delivered by licensed caregivers we've personally trained and trust with our own families.

data.heading: How we help
data.intro: Care plans are written with you and your loved one in the same room. Every caregiver is licensed, bonded, family-vetted, and matched to the temperament and routine that fits.

items.title: Companion care
items.description: A familiar face for the parts of the week when family can't be there. Conversation, meal prep, light housekeeping, errands, transportation to appointments, and steady company that builds into real friendship.
bullets: Same caregiver every visit when possible
Mobile updates after every shift if family asks

items.title: Personal care
items.description: Bathing, dressing, grooming, mobility assistance, medication reminders. Our caregivers are CBRF-certified and trained in respectful, dignity-first approaches.
bullets: Fall-risk and bathing safety assessments included
Long-term care insurance accepted and billed direct

items.title: Dementia & Alzheimer's specialty
items.description: Specially trained caregivers who understand sundowning, communication patterns, and what a 'good day' looks like. We work with your loved one's existing routine — we don't impose ours.
bullets: Care plans coordinated with neurologist + family
Continuity of caregiver to reduce confusion

items.title: Hospice & end-of-life support
items.description: When the time comes, we partner with your hospice team to provide the continuous bedside presence that lets family rest, eat, and grieve together. We've walked this road many times.
bullets: Coordination with your hospice nurse and chaplain
Family communication built into every shift

data.heading: Meet the caregiver before any care begins
data.subtitle: Free in-home consultation. We bring the proposed caregiver, your loved one tells us what matters to them, and you say yes or pick someone else. No commitment until everyone's comfortable.
bullets: Free in-home assessment — no obligation, no pressure
Match-or-replace caregiver guarantee for the first two weeks
Care plan written WITH the family, not delivered TO them
